summary: Mobile frontend review reached registration and Today, then failed when the newly added task did not appear; downstream flows were not executed in this run.

integration_issues.issue: After entering 'UI regression task' and tapping add-task, the task was not visible after 900ms, so completion could not be tested.

action_items: Investigate addTask refresh timing/error handling and ensure the created task is rendered deterministically after add-task.
critical_code_review_comments: addTask calls refresh() without awaiting it and has no try/catch or visible error state; this can make a successful or failed POST appear as a silent no-op.
seed_data_creation: Created one unique example.com account during UI testing; no other seed data intentionally created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Logged-out sign-in, switch to create mode, and unique-account registration passed. Failure occurred immediately after add-task: task text was absent after 900ms. A fresh browser context returned to logged-out state, so do not assume session persistence across automation runs.
rca_of_issue: Likely frontend async/state handling: addTask awaits POST but invokes refresh() without await and without catch. Reproduce by registering, entering a task, tapping data-testid=add-task, and checking Today; capture network response and dashboard response to distinguish API failure from stale render. No API was mocked.
